name: @chaoticgoodcomputing/annotator-format
description: The Annotator's annotation note format: finding a note's annotation blocks, reading each one's record, writing and removing them, and where the note's preface and epilogue are. No Obsidian, DOM or Node in it.
//license: Written to reproduce Upstream's blocks byte for byte, from Upstream's code for them (the plugin's src/annotationUtils.tsx, AGPL-3.0), so under the same license, in its own copy: LICENSE.md.
//exports: Source only: no build and no dist. Whoever uses it compiles it, and Node strips its types for the tests.
//scripts: Node strips the types (unflagged only from Node 22.18; the repo's .nvmrc is 22.16), so sources import each other with their .ts extension. The source is checked without Node's types, so that it uses none of Node; the tests with them.
